title: Companies Act 2006 ss.248, 249, 355, 356 and the Model Articles for private companies, arts. 11 and 15
source: Companies Act 2006 c.46, revised text up to date to 7 October 2026; Companies (Model Articles) Regulations 2008 SI 2008/3229, Schedule 1. Read on legislation.gov.uk 2026-10-09.

rules.text: Minutes of every directors' meeting are recorded and kept for at least ten years.
Minutes signed by the chair of the meeting or of the next one are evidence of the proceedings; the minutes carry the chair's signature line.
Directors decide at a meeting only with a quorum (two unless fixed otherwise); the minutes say one was present.
Every decision of the directors is recorded and the record kept ten years.
Minutes of general meetings and written resolutions are kept ten years.
